falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes above 5,600 on any day within the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 75% pattern match to bottom_2024_aug is invalidated because the August 2024 bottom was followed by a sustained rally from lower levels (~5,200 area); a breakout above 5,600 this quickly would indicate the current structure is not a comparable bottom but rather a continuation pattern or different regime entirely

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 12.00 for 3 consecutive trading days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A BLOWOFF SCORE of 40 suggests elevated stress/uncertainty that typically accompanies washout bottoms; sustained VIX compression below 12 would demonstrate complacency inconsistent with bottom formation and would signal the 'HOLD' was wrong—this was not accumulation zone but distribution before further advance without retest

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield breaks above 4.75% and holds above it for 2 consecutive closes
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom occurred with yields peaking and rolling over; if yields spike to new cycle highs instead, it breaks the macro analog—higher rates would pressure equities directly and invalidate the bottom pattern match, proving the current signal was a false positive for a low
